_comment: Titan-slayer theme (CLAUDE.md §4.3 decision, 2026-07-27). Cards are DATA (§11). 'starter_deck' = each hunter's opening deck; 'reward_pool' = cards offered between encounters (build step 4 meta-progression). Combo cards target an ally or the Titan to reward coordination (§6): cover/rally help your ally, expose/harpoon set up focus-fire, draw_aggro tanks a telegraphed hit for your ally.

expose.name: Expose
expose.text: Expose the Titan: its next 2 hits taken deal +4.

draw_aggro.name: Draw Aggro
draw_aggro.text: You become the Titan's target this round. Gain 6 Block.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.text: Deal 8 damage, then Expose the Titan (1).

scramble.name: Scramble
scramble.text: Climb (+1 Height) toward the weak point.

grip.name: Grip
grip.text: Climb the Titan (+2 Height). Reach a high weak point.

sunlight_blade.name: Sunlight Blade
sunlight_blade.text: Deal 5 damage, +3 for each Exposed stack on the Titan.

bowshot.name: Bowshot
bowshot.text: Deal 3 damage and Expose the Titan (1).

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.text: Gain 2 Strength — your attacks deal +2 for the rest of this fight.

rend.name: Rend
rend.text: Deal 4 damage and apply Wound 2 (the Titan bleeds each turn).

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.text: Deal 4 damage twice (each hit can strike an Exposed weak point).

tongue_lash.name: Tongue Lash
tongue_lash.text: Deal 3 damage and pull yourself up (+1 Height).

build_grapple.name: Build Grapple
build_grapple.text: Build a Grappling Hook and add it to your hand.

grapple.name: Grappling Hook
grapple.text: Fire the hook — time it! Climb +3 on a good throw. Miss and it slips away.

vine.name: Vine
vine.text: Climb (+1); grow a vine that lifts your ally (+2 Height).

spore.name: Spore Burst
spore.text: Deal 2 damage and Poison 2 (the beast bleeds each turn).

rope_up.name: Rope Up
rope_up.text: You and your ally both climb (+1 Height).

belay_strike.name: Belay Strike
belay_strike.text: Deal 3 damage, +2 for each Height you've climbed.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.text: Time it! Pounce for 4 (+5 nailed) and pull up +1 Height. Miss and it slips away.

flick.name: Tongue Flick
flick.text: Time it! Flick the sigil for 2 (+3 nailed). Miss and it slips away.

lash_out.name: Lash Out
lash_out.text: Time it! Whip for 3 (+4 nailed), Poison 2, and a vine lifts your ally +1.

creeper.name: Creeper Vine
creeper.text: Time it! Vine up +1 (+2 nailed); your ally climbs +1. Miss and it slips away.

piton_drive.name: Piton Drive
piton_drive.text: Time it! Drive a piton: 2, +2 per Height climbed (+4 nailed).

haul.name: Haul Up
haul.text: Time it! Both climb +1 (you +2 more nailed). Miss and it slips away.

piston_punch.name: Piston Punch
piston_punch.text: Time it! A massive timed blow: 8 (+8 nailed). Miss and it slips away.
